text:
sara: Heads-up: emergency patch for 1.9.8 — memory leak in kv-cache causing OOMs on long-running dedicated pools. Need a minimal diff hotfix, cutoff in ~90m. Can we coordinate quick?

james: I can cut a branch. plan: create hotfix/1.9.8-minimal, cherry-pick the one commit that fixes cache flush, bump patch, run CI, and tag.

miguel: tagging + CI smoke + perf run on small sample — I can take CI and canary. ETA ~30m after branch is ready.

sara: @james please only include the commit 0b7c3e2 and the version bump. No refactors. Keep changelog entry extremely short.

james: noted. will open branch and put a short PR. PR title: "hotfix: 1.9.8 fix kv-cache leak (minimal)"

olivia: Quick reminder — release cut tooling enforces tests on linux-x86, linux-arm, and gpu-ci. If we have flaky tests, mark them skipped with a comment linking this thread.

maria: I'll prepare the changelog blurb and update release notes page after tag. Suggest changelog: "fix(kv-cache): prevent memory leak during long sessions — critical hotfix"

sara: also: rollback plan — if post-deploy regressions appear, we should revert tag and roll back to 1.9.7. @miguel can you keep an eye on latency/error rate dashboards for 30m after canary?

miguel: yep, will watch and script an alert threshold. If +50% errors or +200ms p50, we revert.

james: branch created: hotfix/1.9.8-minimal -> pushing PR now. CLI commands I ran:```bash
git checkout -b hotfix/1.9.8-minimal
git cherry-pick 0b7c3e2 --no-commit
# apply version bump
git commit -am "chore: bump version to 1.9.8 (hotfix)"
git push origin hotfix/1.9.8-minimal
```

ci-bot: CI started for PR #4321 — linux-x86: queued, linux-arm: queued, gpu-ci: queued

james: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 — reviewers: @olivia @sara. minimal diff (3 files).

olivia: reviewing now. quick code skim looks good. only nit: add a tiny comment near cache flush to explain edge case.

james: added comment in the PR. merging once CI green and @sara gives go.

ci-bot: linux-x86: passed, linux-arm: passed, gpu-ci: failed (timeout on model runner).

miguel: GPU timeout is unrelated to patch; retrying gpu-ci job.

ci-bot: gpu-ci: passed on retry. All checks green.

sara: merging. After merge, @release-bot please create tag v1.9.8 and start canary in us-west-2 with 5% traffic.

release-bot: Tag v1.9.8 created by sara. Canary rollout started: us-west-2, 5% traffic -> 25% in 10m -> 100% in 30m if stable. CI artifact: quay.io/redwood-inference/platform:1.9.8-hotfix

maria: changelog updated in /docs/releases/1.9.x.md with the short blurb and link to PR.

miguel: canary metrics look clean at 5% for first 7m. no error spike. continuing to 25%.

olivia: quick note for release notes: mark this as high priority patch. Communications: @support if any customer reports, escalate to oncall.

sara: thanks everyone. Post-deploy check in 40m for final sign-off, then we'll ship full rollout. If anything odd, revert tag and open incident channel. :thumbsup:
